She stated that the central bank does not feel urgency for further rate hikes at this time. Bowman's comments came after a recent rate increase that set the target range to 3.75%-4.00%. Additionally, she addressed the need for stronger oversight in light of recent bank failures.

title: Jio IPO sparks investor buzz: GMP hits 20% as Reliance’s telecom arm announces price band, dates
description: Jio Platforms’ IPO grey market premium climbed to Rs 220 after the company filed its red herring prospectus (RHP) on Wednesday. The GMP implies a nearly 20% premium over the upper price band of Rs 1,119. The Rs 30,213 crore IPO, opening on October 21 and closing on October 23, is set to surpass Hyundai Motor India’s 2024 offering to become India’s largest-ever public issue.

title: Jio IPO: 5 strengths that put the Reliance-backed digital giant in spotlight
description: Reliance Jio Platforms has highlighted five key strengths in its RHP ahead of its Rs 30,213 crore IPO, including strong revenue growth, profitability, a vast customer base, extensive network infrastructure and proprietary technology. The company also sees growth opportunities in fixed broadband, AI-led services, digital subscriptions and overseas technology monetisation.

title: Sebi confirms interim curbs on Rajesh Exports, says financial disclosure concerns remain unresolved
description: Sebi has confirmed interim restrictions on Rajesh Exports and promoter Rajesh Mehta, citing unresolved concerns over financial disclosures, possible misrepresentation and the routing of company funds through personal accounts. The regulator said gaps in consolidated revenue disclosures and missing supporting records remain, while directing the company to maintain accurate financial and related-party disclosures.

title: IPO ahead! Paramotor Digital Technology files updated draft papers with Sebi for Rs 1,000 crore issue
description: Paramotor Digital Technology has filed updated draft IPO papers with Sebi for a Rs 1,000 crore issue, comprising a fresh issue of Rs 698 crore and an offer for sale of Rs 302 crore. The fintech company plans to use the proceeds primarily for customer acquisition, technology development and business expansion.

title: HDB Financial Q2 profit climbs 34%, NIM improves year on year, eyes stronger disbursements in H2
description: HDB Financial Services reported a 34% year-on-year increase in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 780 crore, supported by higher net interest income, loan growth and lower credit costs. The lender expects festive demand and stronger disbursements to drive growth in the second half and declared an interim dividend of Rs 2 per share.

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
